query:
REPLACE INTO auth_rebac_relations (subject_entity_type,
                                               subject_entity_id,
                                               relationship,
                                               object_entity_type,
                                               object_entity_id)
            SELECT value ->> 'subject_entity_type',
                   value ->> 'subject_entity_id',
                   value ->> 'relationship',
                   value ->> 'object_entity_type',
                   value ->> 'object_entity_id'
            FROM json_each($1)
